active_parameter_count_definition: materialized GPT parameters; never substitute latent trainable count
diagnostic_caveat: one optimizer trajectory is not the global manifold of good solutions; 239 states and 100 exact probes remove the previous rank-19 sampling ceiling only for representative layers
diagnostic_protocol: record paired dense mlp.c_fc and mlp.c_proj weights for layers 0, 6, and 11 at every step 0 through 238 in float16; record exact pre-step clipped gradient, momentum, combined momentum, Muon polar direction, and applied direction for both MLP matrices in layer 6 at 100 deterministic horizon-covering steps; analyze centered and uncentered spectra, temporal mean shift, held-out basis transfer, and budgeted fast-transform fit
eval_batch_shape_policy: shared b16 evaluation independent of rung training microbatch; ordered fixed train/val windows and token budget must match the dense ladder
instability_policy: hard reject NaN, Inf, divergence, failed terminal evaluation, missing probe, or snapshot identity mismatch
monitoring_policy: persistent watchdog required because diagnostic I/O makes expected duration exceed five minutes; callbacks at 20/50/100 plus failure/stall with event-specific continuation prompts
operator_override: 2026-08-26: replace the 20-snapshot rank ceiling with 239 selected-layer paired states and 100 exact gradient/Muon probes; fit fast transform bases at 0.1 to 1 percent budgets before another structural training candidate
prelaunch_provenance_requirements: record commit, entrypoint, exact command, resolved config SHA256, training/helper source hashes, data manifest SHA256, runtime fixed-evaluation index digest, snapshot/probe inventories, and watchdog identity
schedule_rounding: ceil(planned_tokens / tokens_per_iter); lr decay and terminal eval occur at max_iters
terminal_eval_protocol: evaluate at max_iters even when it is off periodic cadence
